prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production TRANSPARENT pixel-art animation atlas for a Japanese shrine-maiden summoner in a polished arcade/JRPG side-scrolling idle RPG. Reference image is locked pixel shading and palette guidance only unless identified as SAME SUBJECT. Deliberate clean square pixel clusters, dark crisp colored outlines, ivory highlights, violet-grey shadows, vermilion/white/gold shrine accents; no smooth illustration, painted gradients, blur or 3D. Real transparent RGBA, no painted checkerboard, floor, cast shadow, text, border, labels, separators or grid. All frame silhouettes fully inside x=.10..90,y=.10..90 with wide EMPTY transparent gutters. Same scale, camera, anatomy and palette across cells. Create exactly 3 frames in ONE horizontal row of equally sized square cells. Subject: ONE ivory/vermillion sacred cat with TWO ears, ONE curling tail, amber eyes, riding a single golden flaming wheel; cat remains upright while wheel turns; tiny red neck tassel. ONE creature per cell, facing RIGHT, no effects baked into body. Position: cat head (.62,.36), wheel center (.48,.61), wheel bottom on .82. Idle loop: 1 exhale/relaxed; 2 chest/head rise one logical pixel and wings/tail lift two; 3 ease halfway back. Feet stay planted for ground creatures, hover center stays fixed for flying.
